behavior_rules.rule: Represents a mass of tiny creatures acting as one.
Normally occupies a 10' x 30' area, but may expand or shrink as conditions merit.
Not particularly predisposed to fight.
Morale roll may be made once each round unless under another's control.

steps.step: Any character within the swarm is automatically hit; no attack roll is needed.
A character may ward off the swarm with a torch, weapon, or similar object, or may flee it.
Warding off a swarm with a torch or weapon inflicts 1d4 damage to the swarm.
Fire-based and cold-based attacks damage a swarm.
A sleep spell causes the entire swarm to go dormant.
If a character flees, it takes 3 rounds to swat off remaining creatures, during which the character may continue to suffer the swarm's effects.
If the character flees into a body of water, the remaining creatures are removed in 1 round.
Any swarm that has suffered damage will chase a fleeing character.
If the character leaves the swarm's line of sight, the swarm cannot pursue.

attack_effect.effect: Double damage to characters wearing no armor or monsters with AC 3 or worse. Damage is halved if the character wards the swarm off or runs out of it.
